title: How One Unsent Text Teaches a Godly Man to Govern His Mouth
caption:
The text you didn't send is a rep.

Write it, wait a night, reread it as the one receiving it, then notice you survived.

What's the draft sitting in your notes right now?

#faith #selfcontrol #discipline #godlymen #christianman #proverbs29
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
